exifr 7.1.3 (full UMD bundle), MIT licensed.

Source: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/exifr/7.1.3

`exifr.js` is the unmodified `dist/full.umd.js` from that release.
The license is included in LICENSE. Served locally; no CDN requests are made
when reading image metadata. Unsupported proprietary maker notes remain binary
and are represented by their byte length in the website's JSON export.
